name: Forno Acqua AcquaSPA Brushed Nickel 8" Retrofit Shower System
shortDescription: Transform your bathroom into a personal spa with the FORNO ACQUA AcquaSPA Shower column. This wall-mounted system features a 6-function 8" rain shower head, 5-function handheld, and three adjustable body jets designed to deliver full-body comfort and customizable water flow. The sleek 6-way diverter lets you combine or control water outlets effortlessly. Built from durable stainless steel with a matte black finish, this bold shower solution blends modern style with long-lasting performance. Easy to install using existing plumbing, the AcquaSPA System is perfect for DIY upgrades and quick bathroom remodels. It offers the perfect balance of convenience, luxury, and design.

features.text: Shower Column Brushed Nickel with Body Jets
Patented 6-Function 8" Rain Shower Head for a Personalized Spa Experience: Enjoy a luxurious full-body experience with six soothing overhead spray modes
5-Function Handheld Shower with 60" Hose for Targeted Relief: Ergonomic handheld sprayer includes Rain, Massage, Pulse and Combo functions.

3 AcquaSPA Adjustable, Directional Body Jets are Precisely Spaced for True Full-Body Relief: Experience targeted relief for upper, mid, and lower muscle zones - customized spa-quality comfort for every body
Easy DIY Installation with Existing Plumbing on Flat or Uneven Surfaces: Fits standard plumbing - quick, no-fuss at-home installation
6-Way Diverter Offers Full Control of Shower Functions: Switch with ease; rain shower, handheld, or jets. Mix and match for a custom spa feel.
Integrated Sliding Bar with Adjustable Holder for Handheld Flexibility: Adjustable handheld shower, custom height and angle for easier use by children, seniors, and every family member.
